feature: Dismissible retention notices and automatic first-visit page guides

implementation.retention_notices: Dismissed banners collapse to a small policy/expiry-date link. Generic notices share a preference; result-specific notices are remembered separately. JSON export and server retention are unchanged.
implementation.page_guides: Automatic once per browser/page type, with close/skip and manual replay. Editing input before the initial prompt defers it. Browser Back removes the modal and restores page interaction.
implementation.previews: Animated expansion, molecule/reaction drawing, protein structure, result charts, data panels, Agent memory, examples and exports; explicitly illustrative and no inference requests or input mutations.
implementation.preferences: enzymind_ui_preferences_v1; independent of workspace access credentials; at most 100 dismissed notice keys and 100 seen-page keys; in-memory fallback if storage is blocked

production_build.warnings: Existing third-party bundle size and use-client warnings

visual_review: Reaction guide on mobile with unobscured target
validation.scientific_data: Deterministic browser fixtures; real Ketcher/Indigo and Mol* rendering. The change does not alter scientific model behavior.
